production.note: US model years 2017 to 2020. Stuttcars titles the car "Porsche Panamera Turbo (2017 – 2020)". Kelley Blue Book lists a 2020 Panamera Turbo and Turbo Sport Turismo (kbb-2020-panamera), and for 2021: "Panamera Turbo S models, which replace the Panamera Turbo, are powered by a significantly revamped twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8" (kbb-2021-panamera).

body.note: KBB lists the Turbo as "Sedan 4D" (a four-door liftback) and the Turbo Sport Turismo ("the more angular and slightly more practical wagon-like rear end of the Sport Turismo"), which arrived after launch. A long-wheelbase Executive was also sold; it is the same body style.

displacementL.note: 3,996 cc. Ultimate Specs: "Engine displacement : 243.9 cu-in / 3996 cm3" (database).

fuel.note: Gasoline V8; inferred from the listing's description.

drivetrain.note: Stuttcars: all-wheel drive via Porsche Traction Management (PTM).

transmission.note: Porsche Finder: "8-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK), with manual actuation and automatic mode". Cars.com: "8-Speed A/T". DCT is Porsche PDK; no manual was offered.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (listing data). Quote, Porsche Finder listing of a 2017 Panamera Turbo: "Maximum power combustion engine 550 hp" and "550 hp @ 5750 - 6000 rpm". Agreeing: Kelley Blue Book "550 @ 5750 RPM" (kbb-2017-panamera-turbo) and Cars.com "550 hp" (carscom-2017-panamera-turbo), both databases. Porsche's European launch release, reproduced by Stuttcars, gives "404 kW / 550 hp (at 5,750 rpm)" (a PS figure; stuttcars-panamera-turbo-971). No Porsche Cars North America spec sheet or release was opened.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (listing data and databases). 2017 Panamera Turbo (standard-wheelbase sedan, PDK). Quote, Porsche Finder: "Curb weight 4,398 lb". Kelley Blue Book: "Curb Weight: 4398 lbs." (kbb-2017-panamera-turbo); Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 4,398 lbs" (carscom-2017-panamera-turbo). Three agreeing figures; TrueDelta's "4001 lb." equals the base Panamera's Cars.com figure and is not used.

sources.publisher: Porsche Finder (Porsche pre-owned listing, Porsche Norwell)
sources.title: 2017 Porsche Panamera Turbo (pre-owned listing)

provisionalNote: Power and weight are provisional. Power (550 hp) and weight (4,398 lb) rest on a Porsche Finder pre-owned listing for a 2017 Panamera Turbo, with Kelley Blue Book and Cars.com (databases) agreeing exactly; no Porsche Cars North America spec sheet or release was found. A PCNA 2017 Panamera technical-data sheet or a Car and Driver / Road & Track / MotorTrend spec panel would replace both. Production end year and body list rest on KBB.
